Glossary

Source: vignettes/articles/glossary.Rmd
glossary.Rmd

Terms used across the documentation and the explorer.

Admission level / ICU level. The unit a merged table has one row per: a hospital admission (with its first ICU stay) or an ICU stay. Chosen with analysis_level in merge_sources().

Cohort. The admissions or ICU stays a study is about, selected before any large table is imported (by ICD codes, a SQL definition such as Sepsis-3, or a list of identifiers). See vignette("cohorts").

Cohort-first. rendehR’s order of work: define the cohort, then import only its rows. A study of a few thousand patients never loads the full event tables.

Cohort admission / context admission. A cohort admission is flagged as a member in cohort_info (cohort_index); the patient’s other admissions are kept as context, so history before and after the index stay is available.

Concept. A clinical variable defined once and extracted from every source: heart rate, lactate, norepinephrine exposure. Its definition (items, unit, conversion, plausible range) is a row of the concept configuration. See vignette("concepts") and the concept dictionary.

Flat / ts / dur. The three harmonized tables: flat has one row per admission or ICU stay (age, sex, outcomes, length of stay); ts (time series) has one row per measurement with its time; dur (durations) has one row per exposure interval (a drug infusion, ventilation). See vignette("harmonized-data").

Harmonized schema / merged schema. The per-source schema (<source>_coh_harmonized) holds one source’s flat, ts and dur tables in the common format; the merged schema (by default rendehr) stacks every source, with source_data naming the origin of each row.

Index admission. A patient’s first cohort admission; patient-level analyses (survival, counts of patients) use it.

Plausible range. The bounds of a concept in its configuration. The pipeline keeps every value; clean_by_range(), or clean = "range" in the wide loaders, removes values outside them when an analysis asks for it.

Provenance. The record of where each concept comes from: source table, item codes, SQL and unit conversion, kept in a registry and shown by list_concepts() and in the explorer.

Project. A folder with a configuration file (config/ehr_config.json), credentials, raw data and outputs, loaded with ehr_use_config(). See vignette("projects").

Small-cell rule. Counts of 1-9 are shown as <10 in the explorer, together with any number from which such a count could be recovered, so that screenshots and tables cannot identify individuals.

Source. One database (for example mimic_iv or mimic_iv_demo), described in the source registry. See Data sources.

Stage. One step of the pipeline run by run_one_source(): import the cohort, load the database, build windows, extract concepts, harmonize. See vignette("pipeline").

Time since admission. Every time in the harmonized tables is given in minutes since hospital admission (time_since_hadm_min) and, when there is an ICU stay, since ICU admission (time_since_icu_min).
